name: agent-replay
description: Capture production failures, compare controlled reruns, and turn fixes into regression CI.

interface.longDescription: Debug Python agents locally: capture execution trajectories, inspect failed model and tool steps, compare recorded or fixture replays, and turn fixes into regression checks. Includes a bundled Python SDK and local reports. Requires Python 3.10+ and local desktop execution. Live model replay is optional and requires your own provider credentials; selected captured request data is sent to that provider. Recorded and fixture replay do not call a model provider. Historical replay alone does not prove that downstream agent behavior is fixed.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this agent trajectory and explain the failure.
Add trajectory capture to my Python agent.
Replay the failed tool with a JSON fixture and compare.

publication.release_notes: Adds failure-to-experience extraction, clustering, qualified refund scenarios, portable evaluated-experience exports, and bilingual evaluation reports. Includes local execution metadata and listing icons.
